alpha_union.doc: union of two mattes over the same frame

beam.doc: synthesise the doorway light on the porch from recorded doorway geometry

composite.doc: cast placed parents onto one plate with recorded matrices

cut.doc: segment a piece along a drawn cut polygon (keep or remove), optionally feathered

cutout.doc: apply an alpha matte to a frame: the crop mask becomes the piece edge

draw.doc: vector shapes drawn by the swarm from recorded coordinates

draw_alpha.doc: rasterise a drawn polygon as a matte

erode_alpha.doc: shrink a matte edge to drop background halo

flip.doc: mirror left-right (used to change which way a whole view faces, never as a turn)

hgradient.doc: horizontal light gradient (the light running through the doorway)

largest_blob.doc: keep the largest connected region of a matte

luma_gate.doc: drop dark (shadow) pixels from inside a SAM matte

qd_strokes.doc: render one Quick, Draw! drawing (by key_id) as chalk strokes

recolor.doc: gradient-map luminance onto a drawn colour ramp (the dusk palette)

room_shade.doc: darken the room away from the lamp

sam_mask.doc: rasterise the documented SAM polygons of one frame into an alpha matte (4x supersampled)

silhouette.doc: fill a matte with one colour (a shadow figure)

strokes.doc: render Quick, Draw! strokes as lines

texture_shape.doc: fill a drawn polygon with surface cut from an archive crop

tile.doc: repeat a texture to fill a size

tile_bond.doc: tile a texture in offset, mirrored courses

trim.doc: crop a piece to its alpha bounding box

vgradient.doc: vertical colour gradient from a drawn ramp
